source.title: Clayton et al.2026 — gray-whale ghost-shrimp foraging kinematics
source.scope: Official Europe PMC full XML, selected methods/results and complete Figures 1, 3, 5 actually inspected via its public supplementaryFiles archive. Thirty-nine tag deployments on 16 northern Puget Sound whales; 25 deployments recorded foraging. The study-specific mean orientation was 107.5-degree right roll and -14-degree pitch. These selected orientations are not a universal strategy or fitted skin/jaw controller. Private figures not redistributed.

delphinapterus-leucas.residual: White adult selection only; head/cheek shape, lip seal, soft-tissue volume, tooth details, neck range and optical response remain unmeasured.
